items.title: Daily Briefing
items.script: Here is your daily briefing. This research examines how well kernel machines handle adversarial examples in machine learning. As LLMs move into real-world environments, static training can't keep up with changing conditions A new AI system called MIND helps scientists test material hypotheses automatically. It uses machine learning to refine ideas, run experiments, and validate results through debate. Neocloud IREN is delaying $4 billion in annual revenue from 2026 to early next year because of customer requests.
